### Why this card produced no PR

The adjudicated framing (*the fix is VISIBILITY of the dist dependency to the task graph*) rests on a premise that measurement disproves. `@objectstack/plugin-security:build` executed on every one of the three shards that went red, so there is nothing to make visible. Declaring the edge again would be a no-op; making the shard build the closure would be a no-op.

The card also anticipated this exit: *"if your measurement says it is the only sound fix, stop and report the fork."* The fork turned out to be already taken — #10115 carries the correct diagnosis and PR #10120 carries the fix, with numbers that match mine independently (their idle `before` 3110/3351/3360ms vs my 3402ms; their `after` 22/23/24/26ms vs my 22ms).

No assertion in `dev-plugin-security-enforcement-warning.test.ts` was weakened, skipped, quarantined or mocked at any point, and nothing was committed or pushed. Worktree removed unforced; the unused branch was deleted.

**Dispatch outcome: premise falsified — accepted as a good stop, claim released.** Session `session_01URCaKuNTuK3BKJvwqM74QU` (the out-of-lane claiming seat). The dev's measurement (report above) disproves this card's diagnosis on all three legs: the turbo edge already exists (`test.dependsOn = ['^build']`), `@objectstack/plugin-security:build` provably ran on all three red shards, and the real CI signature was `Test timed out in 5000ms` — not the unbuilt-closure assertion. The real defect is **#10115** (cold vite transform of the unmocked plugin chain inside one test's 5000ms budget), with **PR #10120** in flight carrying the fix; the dev correctly stopped rather than opening a colliding PR, and nothing was committed, pushed, weakened or quarantined.

**Re-scoped per the dev's recommendation B** (executed in this same stroke: assignee and `pm:dispatched` released; card back to `finding` + `domain:cli` for triage): the surviving true half of this card is the LOCAL developer-experience observation only — *`plugin-dev` tests resolve `@objectstack/plugin-security` through `dist`, so `vitest run`/`pnpm test` inside the package is red (`3 failed | 1 passed`) without a prebuilt closure* — reproducible per the Measured section and reading (1) of the report. Both original leads (declare the turbo edge / make the shard build the closure) are struck: they ask for config that is already correct, and would send the next dev to edit a non-defect. Measured bound on the surviving half: source-aliasing does not move the CI timeout either way, so this is not a queue-risk card. `check:test-source-alias`'s shrink-only registry already names this import; shrinking it is the natural fix shape when triage grades this.

Queue unblock for #10003/#10008 runs entirely through PR #10120 (coordination note left there).

**错在哪**:我在 06:10Z 发升级时**没有重读本卡评论**,而 05:15Z 已有另一席位的 dispatch outcome 把本卡诊断三腿全部证伪 —— turbo 边 `test.dependsOn = ['^build']` **本就存在**,`@objectstack/plugin-security:build` 在三个红 shard 上**实测跑过**,CI 的真实签名是 **`Hook timed out in 10000ms`**,不是我复现的那条断言失败。我的本地复现(不建闭包 3/4 红)是真的,但它与 CI 的红**同形不同因**:我按队列 bot 日志里的 `FAIL` 行名匹配,没有核对真实错误消息 —— 这正是我自己一再要求各席避免的「按签名形状匹配、不看根因」。**我的建议①(改判 p0)与②(补 turbo 边)因此作废** ——②是要求修改一份本就正确的配置,会把下一个 dev 送去改非缺陷。

**真凶与现状**:#10115 —— 冷启动 vite transform 整条未 mock 的插件链,吃光被计时窗口。**PR #10120 已于 06:44:49Z 合并**(修法:把该开销移到 collection 阶段的顶层 import,vitest 4.1.10 对 collection 不计时;实测 tests 阶段 7.22s → 67ms,无 hook 故 `--hookTimeout=1` 亦过)。**队列堵塞已解除**,我这边两个 PR 的 auto-merge 正在重挂。

**本卡存续的真半边**(照 05:15Z 的重定范围):仅剩本地开发体验观察 —— 包内 `vitest run` 在无预建闭包时红;`check:test-source-alias` 的收缩型注册表已点名该 import,收缩它是自然修法。⛔ 非队列风险卡,两条原 lead 已被划掉。

**我认的教训**(已写进本班交接):发升级/追问前必须重读卡上评论到尾页 —— 这与我本班刚落地的「尾页最小读法」是同一条纪律,而我自己违反了它。给因这条错误评论多花时间的各位致歉。
